answer: Lock each epoch's reward in a vault that opens only at the dawn of a later epoch, and only if the identity has since completed verified work for a set of counterparties it has never served before. A lone agent reaches its zenith by steadily widening its circle of real collaborators, one epoch at a time. A farm must keep every fake alive across the whole lock period and invent fresh, distinct counterparties for each one — the longer the vault stays shut, the more the cost of fakes compounds beyond any payout.
